newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were unchanged on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday as Audi shares held steady at Tuesday's $16.625 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares at $12.
Solidere A shares rose slightly to $10.75 from $10.625 while B shares fell to $10.875 from $11.25.
Turnover in BLC was 4,000 shares from 1,000 and 50,000 Audi shares changed hands against 33,750 on Tuesday. Turnover in Audi included a block of 25,000 shares traded outside the floor at $16.5.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 72,878 shares for a value of $938,724 against 85,150 shares for a value of $1,038,600.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.97 percent to 914.58 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.22 percent to 81.14.
